name: Supplies for the Crossroads
summary: Thork needs supplies back at the Crossroads after Razormane quilboar raids. The stolen crates hold provisions the outpost needs amid conflict across the Barrens.

sections.title: A Lifeline Under Siege
sections.body: Thork needs provisions restored to the Crossroads after a supply caravan is ambushed. The outpost links Horde travel, trade, and defense across the Barrens, and cargo arrives from Durotar and Mulgore. Without it, shortages of provisions, tools, and arms threaten daily life in the harsh wilderness.

sections.title: Thieving Quilboar
sections.body: Razormane quilboar have taken the crates. These swine-beasts contest Horde control across central Kalimdor. They hauled the cargo to their thorn-bush camps and keep it there. Thork sends trusted warriors into Razormane territory to recover the supplies for the Horde.

aliases: who starts supplies for the crossroads
faq.answer: Thork, the Horde officer overseeing the Crossroads' defense and operations, gives the request.

faq.q: Why were the supplies stolen in the first place?
faq.answer: Razormane quilboar ambushed a supply caravan headed toward the Crossroads and hauled the crates to their nearby camps.

faq.q: Where can the stolen crates be found?
faq.answer: Crossroads Supply Crates lie scattered on the ground throughout Razormane camps east and northeast of the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why is recovering these supplies so important to Thork?
faq.answer: Thork needs the supplies to keep the Crossroads operating and secure. Lost caravans leave soldiers and travelers without necessities at this isolated outpost.
This follows 'Disrupt the Attacks', in which adventurers struck at Razormane forces to weaken their attacks on Horde travel routes.
The Razormane are a fierce, territorial tribe of quilboar native to the Barrens. They raid caravans and contest the Horde's presence on their ancestral lands.

angles.text: For the Horde, holding the Crossroads links the capitals in Durotar and Mulgore. Recovering ambushed freight keeps the frontier outpost supplied.
As an orc, protecting Horde supply lines from quilboar helps guard the new Horde's expanding settlements.
